claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, JNJ-26481585 (quisinostat) kills cells predominantly through HDAC inhibition, with a class-typical pattern of broad but lineage-selective antiproliferative/cytotoxic activity rather than a single dominant off-target effect.
